meta.mainTitle: Mavj Quiz (Мавч) — SMS quiz with prizes
meta.mainDescription: Mavj (Мавч) is a daily SMS quiz for Tcell, MegaFon and Babilon-M subscribers: answer questions, earn points and win iPhone 17 Pro Max, Apple Watch and AirPods. Subscribe — *3033*1#.

hero.badge: The current period draw is live
hero.subtitle: A daily SMS quiz. Earn points and win an iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods every period.

prizes.title: Three prizes every period
prizes.subtitle: The prize goes to the leader of each place who reaches the points threshold. If the threshold isn't reached, the prize rolls into the jackpot.

subscribe.title: Subscribe
subscribe.desc: Dial *3033*1#. 1.60 TJS per day, all operators in Tajikistan.

answer.title: Answer
answer.desc: Up to {{questions}} questions a day via SMS: 5 basic and 9 in the extra pack.

collect.title: Earn points
collect.desc: 5–10 points per correct answer, up to {{max}} a day.

prize.title: Get a prize
prize.desc: The top 3 of the period win an iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods.

check.title: Check your result
check.subtitle: Enter the number your subscription is registered to.
check.phoneError: Enter 9 digits of the number, e.g. 90 123 4567

result.first: You're in the running for iPhone 17 Pro Max
result.second: You're in the running for Apple Watch Series 11
result.third: You're in the running for AirPods 4
result.left_one: {{value}} point left to the AirPods threshold
result.left_other: {{value}} points left to the AirPods threshold

winners.title: Winners of the period
winners.privacy: Numbers are partially hidden for privacy.

empty.title: First winners coming soon
empty.text: Results will be announced after the first period ends. Subscribe and earn points — your number could appear here.

tariffs.title: Transparent prices
tariffs.subtitle: No hidden fees. The extra pack is activated only with your consent.

oneNumber.title: 1 number — 1 player
oneNumber.desc: Each number is registered once. Multiple accounts are not allowed.

timer.title: 1 minute to answer
timer.desc: The timer starts when you receive a question. Only the first answer counts.

reset.title: Points reset
reset.desc: Points are reset at the start of every period.

jackpot.title: Jackpot
jackpot.desc: If the threshold isn't reached, the prize rolls over to the next draw.

antifraud.title: Anti-fraud
antifraud.desc: Bots are detected automatically. Violators are disqualified.

stop.title: Unsubscribe: STOP
stop.desc: Send STOP to 3033 to unsubscribe at any time.

contact.title: Have a question? Write to us
contact.text: Our support team will answer questions about subscriptions, points and prize collection.
contact.successText: We'll get back to you shortly.
